title: No Fraction Zone
topic: Equations with fractions: clear the denominators (Instant Replay)

scenes.say: Math Blitz, day six! Instant Replay time. Fraction Smash slipped by, so we're running it back with a three-step play: welcome to the No Fraction Zone!

scenes.heading: STEP 1: FIND THE LCD
scenes.note: LCD = smallest number every bottom goes into.
scenes.say: x over two plus x over four equals nine. The bottoms are two and four. Smallest number they both go into? Four!

scenes.heading: STEP 2: × 4 EVERYBODY
scenes.note: The 9 gets × 4 too! Biggest trap on the board.
scenes.say: Multiply every single term by four. Two x, plus x, equals thirty six. Yes, the nine gets times four too!

scenes.heading: STEP 3: FINISH IT
scenes.say: Three x equals thirty six, so x equals twelve. Check it: six plus three is nine. Fractions? Gone!

scenes.ask: What is the value of x?
scenes.say: Your turn, champ! Twenty five XP on the line. x over three plus x over four equals seven. Find the LCD, multiply every term. What is x? Tap your answer below the video!

question.prompt: x/3 + x/4 = 7. What is the value of x?
question.explain: The LCD of 3 and 4 is 12. Multiply every term by 12: 4x + 3x = 84, so 7x = 84 and x = 12. Check: 12/3 + 12/4 = 4 + 3 = 7.

trap_notes.2: Multiplied each fraction by its own bottom (x + x = 84)
trap_notes.3: Added the bottoms like x/7 + x/7 (2x/7 = 7)

rapid.prompt: Leo biked 1/3 of a trail, then 1/4 of it, then the last 10 km. How long is the whole trail?

rapid.why: × 12 every term: 3x + 2x = 60, so 5x = 60. No need to find x!
